legal_and_scientific_status.frozen_before_execution: This contract was frozen before any Gate 1D-C execution, runner invocation, trajectory, model step, result generation, candidate-outcome inspection, scientific classification, or outcome interpretation.
legal_and_scientific_status.prospective_only: This is a prospective operational amendment, never a retrospective interpretation.
legal_and_scientific_status.scope: It resolves only execution authorization, single-attempt durability, publication, abnormal termination, recovery, mechanical finalization, and result-commit mechanics.
legal_and_scientific_status.limited_supersession: Only the original protocol command that uses shell stdout redirection and the original incomplete manifest-finalization mechanics are superseded. All scientific content remains governed by the original protocol and plan.
legal_and_scientific_status.conflict_rule: Any actual or suspected scientific conflict, or any disagreement between this JSON and the Markdown addendum, causes fail-closed refusal before execution or finalization.

artifact_inventory.completion_meaning: sole scientific execution authorization durably consumed

artifact_inventory.producer: runner immediately before the first scientific call becomes reachable
artifact_inventory.completion_meaning: scientific execution entered or could have entered
validated 6000-row trace published; not runner completion
complete non-authoritative execution log durably published; not runner completion

runner_summary_completion_contract.completion_serialized_order: Lexicographic key order imposed by serialization.summary_json_bytes sort_keys=True; no additional completion key is permitted.
runner_summary_completion_contract.self_hash_rule: The summary contains no summary SHA-256 or byte count because that would be recursive. Its registered_artifacts.summary flags defer both to MANIFEST.md. The finalizer computes summary SHA-256 and byte count after validating exact summary bytes.

serialization.strict_json_parse: UTF-8 without BOM; reject duplicate object keys; reject NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, trailing data, comments, invalid UTF-8, and every non-JSON token.
serialization.finite_numbers: Every JSON number must be finite; Boolean is not accepted where a number is required.
serialization.ordered_json_bytes: For receipt and execution-start control artifacts, construct fields in the exact registered order, use json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=False), append one LF byte, and encode UTF-8. No spaces, BOM, CR, or additional bytes are permitted.
serialization.canonical_json_bytes: For contract canonical hashing and nested canonical evidence rendering, use json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False), UTF-8, with no final newline.
serialization.summary_json_bytes: Use json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, indent=2), append exactly one LF, and encode UTF-8.
serialization.trace_json_line_bytes: Each trace row is sorted-key compact strict JSON using canonical_json_bytes followed by exactly one LF.
serialization.gzip: Concatenate the 6000 trace JSON lines in registered order and encode one gzip member with filename empty, mtime=0, compresslevel=9, no optional comment or extra field. Validation must decompress, reserialize every row, recompress with this rule, and require byte identity.
serialization.text: All text artifacts use UTF-8 without BOM, LF only, no NUL, and exactly one final LF.

temporary_files.placement: Every temporary file is a direct child of results/v3.0/gate1dc and therefore on the destination filesystem.
temporary_files.creation: Open the exact temporary path with O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL and O_NOFOLLOW where available, mode 0600, after lstat proves the name absent. Never use a random or alternate temporary name.
temporary_files.same_filesystem: Before writing, require st_dev of the open temporary file to equal st_dev of the result directory; refuse otherwise.
temporary_files.publication: Write all bytes, flush, fsync the file, chmod 0444, fsync again, close, then create the final path atomically with link(temp, final) after lstat proves final absent. Require the link to fail on collision. fsync the destination directory before the final path counts as durable. Then unlink the temporary alias and fsync the directory again. No alternate publication primitive is permitted.
temporary_files.post_receipt_residue: After any execution-receipt path exists, an exception, signal, SIGKILL, power loss, or interpreter termination must preserve every temporary and final residue. Only the normal in-process unlink of a temporary alias after its final link is durably fsynced is allowed. A recovery finalizer may unlink a leftover alias only after proving it is the same inode as its complete valid final path, thereby completing publication without discarding unique bytes. No other later cleanup is allowed.

contract_raw_sha256.source: SHA-256 of the exact committed v30_gate1dc_execution_finalization_contract.json bytes at authorized_execution_sha

contract_canonical_sha256.source: SHA-256 of canonical_json_bytes for the strictly parsed committed contract

source_sha256.source: SHA-256 of exact worktree bytes after byte identity with git show authorized_execution_sha:path is proved

official_invocation.exact: env -i PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin LC_ALL=C LANG=C TZ=UTC PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 EBU_GATE1DC_EXECUTION_SHA=<authorized_execution_sha> /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -B -s -X utf8 exp_v30_gate1dc.py

authorization_consumed_when.exact: the execution_receipt final path exists and the result-directory fsync after its exclusive atomic link has returned success

authorized_sha_verification: Require EBU_GATE1DC_EXECUTION_SHA to exist exactly once in the environment and match ^[0-9a-f]{40}$; reject command-line arguments.

Require repository root, current working directory, branch, local HEAD, tracking ref, and live git ls-remote origin refs/heads/v3.0-local-ebu-foundation all to equal the registered values and authorized execution SHA.
Require a clean index and worktree and no untracked path, including complete absence of results/v3.0/gate1dc.
Require every source_hash_order path to be a tracked regular non-symlink file at authorized_execution_sha and require worktree bytes to equal git show authorized_execution_sha:path bytes.

Strictly parse the plan and contract, verify their raw and canonical hashes, verify the protocol hash 3122aa673f47290bbee866feb56d16afc4540f552ed7c7b458f097ef4e44d04f, and verify every execution-stage locked source hash.
Complete every static, schema, environment, filesystem, Git, live-remote, Python, source-hash, and registered-inventory preflight check before creating the result directory or receipt temporary file.
exclusive_durability_sequence: After all preflight checks pass, create results/v3.0/gate1dc with mkdir mode 0700 and no parents created implicitly; require results/v3.0 to be an existing regular directory and fsync it after mkdir.
Construct the complete receipt bytes in memory and validate them against field_order and field_contract.
Publish using temporary_files.receipt and the registered no-overwrite publication algorithm.
The sole execution authorization is consumed at the first successful result-directory fsync that makes the final receipt link durable.
Reopen the receipt with O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW, require exact byte identity, fsync is already complete, and never truncate, replace, chmod, delete, rename, relink, or reuse the receipt.
absolute_guards: No run_arm, gate1dc_tick, bounded_step, p1c_step, d0 step, model step, runner execution loop, or scientific result construction is imported through a substitutable seam or reachable before receipt durability.
Existence of the receipt final path with valid, malformed, partial, empty, abandoned, or unexpected bytes blocks every later scientific retry.
Any failure after receipt-path creation permanently forbids rerunning any part of the study.
After an incomplete committed attempt, only incident reporting or finalization under recoverable_runner_complete is permitted.

execution_started_control.purpose: Distinguish a merely committed attempt from an attempt in which scientific execution became reachable.

execution_receipt_sha256.source: SHA-256 of exact durable receipt bytes

execution_started_control.publication_and_lock: After receipt durability and before the first scientific function can be called, publish this control artifact durably with its fixed temporary name. Open the final file read-only, acquire an exclusive nonblocking advisory lock, and hold that descriptor and lock until the summary is durable or the process terminates. The first scientific call is lexically and dynamically after successful publication and lock acquisition. Lock release with incomplete runner outputs classifies the residue as FAILED_OR_INTERRUPTED.

pre_receipt_cleanup.permitted_predicate: The execution receipt final path, execution-start final path, stdout, trace, summary, and manifest are all absent; no official runner holds the execution-start lock; the result directory is absent or is a non-symlink directory whose entries are a subset of only .v30_gate1dc_execution_receipt.json.tmp.
procedure: If the receipt temporary file exists, lstat it without parsing or interpreting content; require a regular non-symlink file and unlink only that exact path.
fsync the result directory after unlink; require it empty; rmdir only that exact result directory; fsync results/v3.0.
Do not delete, rename, inspect as an outcome, or modify any other path.
pre_receipt_cleanup.forbidden: If the predicate is false, cleanup and retry are forbidden; preserve residues and create an incident report outside the registered result directory.

official_execution.only_runtime_substitution: AUTHORIZED_EXECUTION_SHA is the single explicitly user-authorized audited 40-lowercase-hex commit SHA. No other command, environment, path, parameter, interpreter, or output substitution is permitted.
shell_lines: env -i PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin LC_ALL=C LANG=C TZ=UTC PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 EBU_GATE1DC_EXECUTION_SHA="${AUTHORIZED_EXECUTION_SHA}" /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -B -s -X utf8 exp_v30_gate1dc.py
official_execution.python_mode: Exact invocation path /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 resolving to /opt/homebrew/Cellar/python@3.14/3.14.2/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.14/bin/python3.14; Python 3.14.2; zlib compile and runtime versions both 1.2.12; flags -B -s -X utf8; empty inherited environment via env -i; fixed PATH, C locale, UTC timezone, deterministic hash seed, and disabled user site-packages.
prohibitions: No shell redirection, pipe, tee, set -o noclobber dependency, >, >|, alternate stdout path, wrapper, module invocation, debugger, profiler, coverage tool, command substitution, scientific option, subset, seed, threshold override, retry, or executable substitution.
No environment variable other than the exact listed environment and EBU_GATE1DC_EXECUTION_SHA.
Preflight rejection exits nonzero to inherited stderr and creates no result directory, receipt, execution-start marker, stdout, trace, summary, manifest, or other registered scientific artifact.

stdout_ownership.capture: The runner replaces print-to-process-stdout with an in-memory io.StringIO log using LF newlines. It does not open the registered stdout path until the trace is durable and every runner output has passed complete in-memory validation.
render_order: registered: 3 worlds x 2 timesteps x 5 arms = 30 runs; 200 ticks each; burn-in 50; measurement 150; no seed
30 run lines in frozen run order, each: run <two-digit-index>/30 | <run_id> | service=<JSON number> | unmet=<JSON number> | ebu=<JSON number> | r_dt=<JSON number>
outcome-class lines in manifest outcome-class order for classes present, each: outcome | <class> | <integer count>
falsifiers fired: <comma-space joined fired F keys in F1-F16 order, or none>
stdout_ownership.flush_close_fsync: After trace publication, render the complete log to UTF-8 bytes under serialization.text, exclusively publish stdout with its fixed temporary path, fsync its file and result directory, close every stdout file descriptor, and retain no writable handle to it before summary publication.
stdout_ownership.after_summary: Nothing may be printed or written to the stdout artifact after summary publication. Post-summary status may be reported only to inherited stderr and must not mutate a registered artifact.

publication_order: 1. Complete all preflight checks with no result artifact, then durably publish the immutable execution receipt.
2. Durably publish and lock the execution-start control artifact, then execute each of the 30 scientific runs exactly once in frozen order.
3. Construct and completely validate all 30 runs, 6000 trace rows, summary, and stdout bytes in memory with no publication.
4. Deterministically render and durably publish the trace.
5. Render, exclusively publish, flush, close, and fsync stdout; retain no writable stdout handle.
6. Durably publish the summary as the sole runner-output completion sentinel.
7. Release the execution-start advisory lock; perform no further stdout write and no scientific work.
8. Invoke the separate mechanical finalizer; durably publish MANIFEST.md as the sole full-study completion sentinel.

shared_predicates.artifact_valid: The path is a mode-0444 regular non-symlink file, has exact registered bytes/schema, has no writable open descriptor held by the runner or finalizer, and satisfies every provenance, hash, ordering, and cross-artifact rule applicable to it. Its st_nlink must equal one plus the count of enumerated exact temporary aliases in the result directory that have the same st_dev and st_ino; this proves no unenumerated outside hard link exists.
shared_predicates.publication_prefix_valid: Ignoring exact registered temporary aliases, runner final artifacts exist only as one prefix of [], [trace], [trace, stdout], [trace, stdout, summary], and every existing final artifact is valid.
shared_predicates.no_unexpected_entries: Every result-directory entry is one of the six registered artifact basenames or six exact temporary names; no subdirectory, symlink, device, socket, FIFO, alternate file, or hard-link target outside the result directory is present.
shared_predicates.recoverable_runner_complete: Receipt, execution-start, trace, stdout, and summary final paths are all valid; manifest is absent; the execution-start lock is not held; summary hashes and byte counts agree with actual artifacts; exact temporary residues may exist but no unexpected entry exists.
shared_predicates.manifest_valid: MANIFEST.md is byte-identical to a fresh deterministic render from the five non-manifest registered artifacts under this contract.

UNSTARTED.filesystem_predicate: results/v3.0/gate1dc does not exist by lexists; therefore no registered or temporary file exists.

PREFLIGHT.filesystem_predicate: The result directory is an empty regular non-symlink directory or contains only the exact receipt temporary file; every registered final path and every other temporary name is absent.
PREFLIGHT.scientific_retry_permitted: Only after pre_receipt_cleanup completes and state returns to UNSTARTED.

ATTEMPT_COMMITTED.filesystem_predicate: A valid execution receipt exists; execution-start, trace, stdout, summary, and manifest are absent; the execution-start lock is absent; no unexpected entry exists. The exact receipt temporary alias may remain after a crash.

EXECUTING.filesystem_predicate: Valid receipt and execution-start files exist; the original official runner holds the exclusive advisory lock on the execution-start file; manifest is absent; publication_prefix_valid and no_unexpected_entries are true.

RUNNER_COMPLETE.filesystem_predicate: recoverable_runner_complete is true and MANIFEST.md is absent.

FINALIZED.filesystem_predicate: recoverable_runner_complete and manifest_valid are true; all six registered final artifacts exist; the execution-start lock is absent; no unexpected entry exists.

FAILED_OR_INTERRUPTED.filesystem_predicate: The filesystem does not satisfy any earlier state in classification_order, including: any receipt path with malformed, partial, empty, or abandoned bytes; receipt-absent execution-start or scientific artifact; released execution lock before recoverable runner completion; invalid publication prefix; invalid artifact; or unexpected result entry.
FAILED_OR_INTERRUPTED.model_state_may_have_advanced: Unknown and therefore treated as possibly advanced.
FAILED_OR_INTERRUPTED.execution_authorization_consumed: True if the execution-receipt final path exists in any form, or if execution-start, trace, stdout, summary, or manifest exists; otherwise false but retry still requires incident resolution and exact pre-receipt cleanup predicate.
FAILED_OR_INTERRUPTED.finalization_permitted: Only if recoverable_runner_complete is mechanically true; otherwise false.

failure_retry_matrix.scientific_retry: Allowed only after the rejected condition is corrected without changing frozen scientific content and the exact invocation is reauthorized with the same audited SHA.
failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Report the failed check; restore the exact required preflight state without source or scientific changes.

failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: Empty result directory or receipt temporary file only.
failure_retry_matrix.scientific_retry: Allowed only after exact pre_receipt_cleanup returns to UNSTARTED.
failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Apply the frozen cleanup predicate and procedure; otherwise incident report.

failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: If no final receipt path exists: PREFLIGHT residue. If any final receipt path exists: receipt plus possible temporary alias.
failure_retry_matrix.authorization_consumed: False only when the final receipt path is absent; true whenever it exists, regardless of validity.
failure_retry_matrix.scientific_retry: Allowed only in the absent-final-path branch after pre_receipt_cleanup; forbidden in the receipt-exists branch.
failure_retry_matrix.cleanup: Pre-receipt cleanup only in the absent-final-path branch; otherwise none.
failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Classify by final receipt-path existence; never infer permission from intended write status.

failure_retry_matrix.failure_point: failure before the first run after execution-start publication
failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: Receipt and execution-start controls, no runner outputs, released lock.
failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Incident report only; model advancement is conservatively unknown.

failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: Control artifacts and no final runner output, with possible temporary residue and released lock.
failure_retry_matrix.scientific_retry: Forbidden permanently, including remaining, failed, or completed run IDs.
failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Preserve residues and report the incident.

failure_retry_matrix.failure_point: aggregation or complete in-memory validation failure
failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: Control artifacts only; no final runner output.
Controls plus trace temporary, trace final, or both; no stdout or summary final.
failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Preserve exact residues and incident report.

failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Preserve exact residues and incident report.

failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: Controls, valid trace and stdout, summary temporary/final/both.

failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Run the frozen finalizer only when recoverable_runner_complete is proven; otherwise incident report.

failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: All five non-manifest registered artifacts, optional exact temporary aliases, no manifest.
failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Invoke the frozen finalizer; never invoke the runner.

failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: Runner-complete artifacts unchanged; no manifest temporary or final because validation precedes writes.
failure_retry_matrix.finalization: A retry is permitted only when the failed check returned EINTR, ETIMEDOUT, ECONNRESET, ECONNREFUSED, EHOSTUNREACH, ENETUNREACH, a DNS-resolution failure, or found the original runner advisory lock still held and that exact transient condition later clears; every byte, source, Git ref, and contract must remain unchanged. Any content, schema, hash, state, or provenance mismatch permanently blocks finalization.
failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Report the exact errno, DNS failure, or held-lock result; after it clears, rerun the unchanged finalizer from validation step 1. For every other failure, incident report only.

failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: Valid runner-complete artifacts and manifest temporary bytes.

failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Mechanically compare preserved temporary bytes to fresh render, then resume link/fsync or remain failed.

failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: All six final artifacts and optional manifest temporary alias; directory fsync may be incomplete.
failure_retry_matrix.finalization: The finalizer may verify exact manifest bytes and repeat directory fsync only; it may not rewrite or relink.
failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Verify bytes, fsync directory, and classify FINALIZED only on success.

failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Reverify hashes/diff and retry only the exact Git staging or commit step.

failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: Valid local result commit not yet present at live remote.

failure_retry_matrix.failure_point: exception, SIGINT, SIGTERM, SIGHUP, SIGKILL, power loss, or interpreter termination at any post-receipt point
failure_retry_matrix.possible_residues: The exact durable prefix and any open temporary file at the interruption point.
failure_retry_matrix.cleanup: No post-receipt cleanup, including from signal handlers or a later process.
failure_retry_matrix.next_action: Allow OS close/lock release, preserve bytes, classify mechanically, and report or finalize as allowed.

finalizer.import_contract: Importing the module performs no Git call, filesystem inspection, file open, parse, print, directory creation, lock, write, scientific import, or other side effect.
finalizer.authorized_actor: Only the repository custodian explicitly authorized to mechanically finalize the already completed Gate 1D-C runner outputs at the audited execution SHA; the actor supplies no wording, value, choice, classification, threshold, or outcome selection.

finalizer.permitted_repository_state: Repository root and branch are exact; local HEAD, tracking ref, and live remote ref all equal EBU_GATE1DC_EXECUTION_SHA; every source_hash_order file equals the receipt hash and the Git blob at that SHA; the index is empty; worktree status consists exactly of the five untracked non-manifest registered artifacts plus allowed exact temporary residues; MANIFEST.md is absent unless resuming its already-linked fsync; no tracked file differs.
validation_order: 1. Validate zero arguments, exact environment allowlist, exact Python invocation path and realpath, Python 3.14.2, zlib compile/runtime 1.2.12, exact flags/mode, repository root, and current working directory.
2. Validate branch, local HEAD, tracking ref, live remote ref, empty index, and exact permitted untracked status without changing Git state.
3. Strictly parse this contract and recompute its raw and canonical hashes; validate the Markdown addendum hash recorded in the receipt and the scientific precedence rule.
4. Validate receipt exact bytes, field order, schema, authorized SHA, source hash order, all source worktree/Git-blob hashes, immutability, and receipt hash.
5. Validate execution-start exact bytes, field order, receipt hash link, authorized SHA, and released advisory lock.

6. Classify recoverable_runner_complete; reject unexpected entries, symlinks, non-regular files, missing files, invalid modes, and overwrite paths. Validate any leftover exact temporary alias by proving it is the same inode as its complete valid final path; do not unlink it during validation.

7. Strictly parse summary with duplicate-key and non-finite rejection; require its exact runner_summary_completion_contract, execution SHA, plan hashes, complete source hashes, registered dimensions, exact equality with registered_execution_inventory.run_ids, scientific summary schema, PC1-PC4 order, H1-H10 order, F1-F16 order, discriminator keys, O3 fields, outcome counts, nonclaims, and runner-completion declaration.

8. Validate trace gzip byte determinism, strict JSON lines, exactly 6000 rows, exact 30-by-200 ordering, ticks 1 through 200 per run, all provenance hashes and SHA, required row fields, and the frozen summary cross-checks. Do not call scientific code.
9. Validate stdout UTF-8/LF/final-newline rules and exact stdout render grammar; require no content after the frozen final line.

10. Compute SHA-256 and byte counts for receipt, execution-start, trace, stdout, and summary; require summary's registered-artifact entries to agree where present and use the computed values for the manifest.
11. Validate every manifest source pointer before rendering; missing, extra, mistyped, non-finite, or inconsistent source data fails closed.
12. Render MANIFEST.md completely in memory under manifest_rendering, rerender independently, require byte identity, and perform no scientific recomputation or interpretation.

13. After every validation and both in-memory renders pass, unlink only verified same-inode temporary aliases of complete valid final paths and fsync the result directory; preserve every other residue.
14. Require MANIFEST.md final and temporary paths absent, then publish with temporary_files.manifest. On resume, follow the exact failure_retry_matrix without overwrite.

15. Reopen and byte-compare the manifest, fsync the result directory, classify FINALIZED, and write exactly 'FINALIZED V3.0 Gate 1D-C at <authorized_execution_sha>: results/v3.0/gate1dc/MANIFEST.md\n' to inherited stderr.
absolute_prohibitions: Do not import gate1dc_v30, exp_v30_gate1dc, service_v30, d0_v29, p1c_v29, ebu_quote_v30, or any project scientific module.

Do not recompute a result with new scientific logic; only validate frozen serialized values and their frozen cross-file identities.
Accept no manual parameter, wording, template, path, output choice, row choice, outcome choice, threshold, tolerance, interpretation, attestation, timestamp, or optional flag.
Never overwrite, truncate, delete, repair, normalize, or edit any input or existing manifest path.
Finalizer failure never permits scientific rerun.

manifest_rendering.title: # EBP V3.0 Gate 1D-C — Finalized Execution Manifest
manifest_rendering.cell_rendering:
For null render null; Boolean true or false lowercase; integer base-10 without leading plus or zeros except 0; finite float via json.dumps(value, allow_nan=False, ensure_ascii=True); string as its exact content with backslash replaced by two backslashes, vertical bar replaced by backslash-vertical-bar, CRLF/CR/LF replaced by
, and no added code ticks; list or object as canonical_json_bytes decoded ASCII then apply string cell escaping.
manifest_rendering.document_grammar: Render title, one blank line, then each section in section_order separated by exactly one blank line. Every heading and fixed paragraph occupies one physical line. Each list item occupies one physical line formed as '- ' plus the rendered item. A table row is '| ' plus cells joined by ' | ' plus ' |'; a table is its header, a separator row using --- in every cell, then data rows, with one LF per row. A paragraph or list immediately follows its heading after one blank line. No trailing spaces. Exactly one final LF.

sections.heading: ## 1. Completion status
fixed_paragraphs: This manifest is the sole full-study completion sentinel. The summary is only the runner-output completion sentinel; summary plus trace never constitutes a finalized study.
The durable execution receipt proves that the sole authorized scientific attempt was committed before scientific execution became reachable.

sections.heading: ## 2. Provenance and source locks
fixed_paragraphs: The original protocol and plan retain precedence over all scientific content. The execution/finalization addendum governs only the prospective operational mechanics explicitly identified there.
Any scientific conflict would have caused fail-closed refusal.

table.row_generator: For index 0..12 in execution_receipt.source_hash_order, render index+1, the path, and receipt:/source_sha256/<JSON-pointer-escaped-path>.

sections.heading: ## 3. Artifact integrity
fixed_paragraphs: MANIFEST.md does not contain its own hash. The finalizer verifies it by rendering the expected bytes twice, atomically publishing them, and reopening for byte identity. The result commit records the manifest as a Git blob; post-commit verification uses the commit tree and git hash-object without recursive self-hashing.

rows: verified by deterministic render and Git blob

sections.heading: ## 4. Frozen execution inventory
fixed_paragraphs: Inventory verification: exactly 30 unique runs in frozen world × timestep × arm order, exactly 200 trace rows per run, ticks 1 through 200, and exactly 6,000 rows overall.

table.row_generator: For index 0..29, run_id = contract:/registered_execution_inventory/run_ids/index; require summary:/registered/frozen_order/index equals run_id, summary:/runs/run_id exists, and trace rows at global indices index*200 through index*200+199 have that run_id and ticks 1..200; render index+1, run_id, present, 200, 1–200.

sections.heading: ## 5. Positive controls PC1–PC4
fixed_paragraphs: F4 remains exactly: certified_lower_bound - 1e-9 * (1 + abs(certified_lower_bound)). There is no second slack floor, tuning interval, or rerun permission.

table.row_generator: For controls [PC1_DC1_S_starves_dst2, PC2_DC3_S_misses_pulses, PC3_DC1_A_vs_B_capability_cost, PC4_DC2_A_vs_B_capacity_gap] and within each labels [conservative, near_certificate], render summary:/positive_controls/<control>/<label> fields measured_as, certified_lower_bound, f4_threshold, executed_value, f4_fired in that order; validate f4_threshold by the exact F4 expression.
For H1 through H10 numerically, render key, plan:/hypotheses/key, summary:/hypotheses/key/status, and canonical JSON of summary:/hypotheses/key/evidence.
For F1 through F16 numerically, render key, plan:/falsifiers/key, summary:/falsifiers/key/fired, and canonical JSON of summary:/falsifiers/key/evidence.

For worlds [DC1_flux_lock, DC2_capacity_split, DC3_demand_pulse] and within each labels [conservative, near_certificate], key = world|label; render summary:/discriminator_v2/key fields i_capability_cost_absolute, ii_service_ratio_delta, iii_max_destination_unmet_delta, world_discriminating.

sections.heading: ## 11. Limitations and nonclaims
fixed_limitations: This is one deterministic, preregistered 30-run study over three frozen worlds and two frozen timesteps; it does not establish external validity.

DC1 and DC3 contain registered structural physical impossibility at destination 1, so whole-run outcome precedence can mask a distributive detector response; PC1 and PC2 validate the per-destination detector rather than forcing a distributive final class.
Positive controls test the registered instrument and capability gaps; they do not predetermine the scientifically open D-versus-B outcome.
Numerical agreement, a supported hypothesis, or an unfired falsifier is empirical evidence under the frozen implementation, not a mathematical guarantee.
Runner completion and full-study finalization are distinct; only this MANIFEST.md establishes finalization.

sections.heading: ## 12. Immutability and next stage
fixed_paragraphs: The execution receipt, execution-start control, runner outputs, and this manifest are immutable registered artifacts. No rerun, replacement, truncation, deletion, manual edit, outcome selection, or post-outcome source, contract, test, schema, threshold, predicate, finalizer, or wording change is permitted.

Single-attempt evidence: the immutable receipt was durably published before the execution-start control; receipt existence consumes the sole execution authorization; the state machine contains no transition back to UNSTARTED after receipt creation.

Next possible stage: separately authorized scientific interpretation of these frozen Gate 1D-C outputs. It has not begun. Gate 1E remains registered and untouched; Gate 2 remains paused; no outcome authorizes either stage.

post_execution_immutability.trigger: The execution-receipt final path exists in any form.
rules: No source, addendum, contract, plan, protocol, test, runner, finalizer, scientific module, constant, threshold, tolerance, schema, template, wording, or interpretation rule may be modified.

Before the exact result commit, no checkout, switch, reset, restore, clean, stash, rebase, pull, merge, cherry-pick, revert, worktree change, branch change, tag change, submodule change, or history rewrite is permitted.

No registered result or temporary residue may be deleted, truncated, replaced, renamed, manually edited, normalized, recompressed, relinked, or copied over, except verified same-inode temporary-alias completion under temporary_files.post_receipt_residue.
No manual manifest creation or editing; MANIFEST.md may only be produced by the frozen finalizer at the exact execution SHA.
No outcome-based selection, filtering, subsetting, rewriting, reclassification, prose choice, or omission.
Finalization must use the exact source and finalizer bytes recorded by the receipt and committed at authorized_execution_sha; any difference fails closed.
The only Git history mutation permitted before push is the exact result commit procedure below; it may add only the six registered final artifacts and may not change their worktree bytes.

preconditions: State is FINALIZED and the finalizer has exited successfully.
Recompute and inspect SHA-256 and byte counts for all six registered artifacts; for MANIFEST.md inspect its Git blob ID instead of requiring a recursive in-content hash.
Run strict receipt, start, trace, summary, stdout, and manifest validation again without scientific imports.
git status --porcelain=v2 shows exactly six untracked registered final artifact paths and no temporary residue in the normal-success path.
git diff --check passes and git diff --no-index /dev/null for each artifact is reviewed; no tracked source-code diff exists.
result_commit_and_push.staging: Run git add -- followed by the six exact paths in allowed_result_commit_files_in_order. Then require git diff --cached --name-only to equal those six paths in that exact order and inspect git diff --cached --stat, git diff --cached -- MANIFEST.md, receipt, execution-start, stdout, and summary plus independent decompressed trace validation and trace hash.
result_commit_and_push.commit_subject_format: Record Gate 1D-C execution and finalization at <AUTHORIZED_EXECUTION_SHA>
result_commit_and_push.commit: Create one normal commit without amend, signing override, hook bypass, path substitution, source change, or additional file.
result_commit_and_push.post_push_verification: Require local HEAD, refs/remotes/origin/v3.0-local-ebu-foundation after an explicit fetch of that ref, and live git ls-remote origin refs/heads/v3.0-local-ebu-foundation to equal the result commit SHA; require a clean index and worktree and reverify all six artifact bytes from the commit.
result_commit_and_push.failure_rule: A staging, commit, fetch, or push failure never permits runner or scientific rerun. Preserve artifacts and any created commit; retry only the failed Git operation after repeating the frozen validation. Force push, amend, rebase, reset, and history rewrite are forbidden.
